impact_assessment.benefits: Hide judge startup latency without reusing a sandbox or changing any verdict, timeout, output limit or run accounting
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first one-use/isolation/timeout/output-limit/dispose tests, sandbox hardening, direct and full-tune old/new hashes, full npm test and 4/4 strict gates; revert on any leak or verdict change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one fresh permission-isolated child per answer with identical env/cwd/heap/timeout/maxBuffer; dependency: node child_process only; concurrency: bounded four idle children; state: process-local pool disposed after each tune
impact_assessment.why: Timed and untuned answers still pay a fresh Node sandbox startup after every generation, although process startup can overlap the preceding model call

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Overlap up to four fresh sandbox judges with the next serial model generation

impact_assessment.benefits: Hide judge startup and execution behind later generation without idle process pools, sandbox reuse or extra model concurrency
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first order/error/bounded-overlap tests, direct and full-tune old/new hashes, full npm test and 4/4 strict gates; revert on ordering or verdict change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ordered results/onItem, one fresh child per answer, identical verdicts/errors/timing stats; dependency: none; concurrency: model width remains one, at most four judges in flight; state: no cache/schema change
impact_assessment.why: Width-one evaluation still waits for each judge child before starting the next model answer, leaving inference and judging entirely serial
